description: Bench cutting tool that rides on runners along a press and carries an adjustable knife advanced by a screw. Drawn back and forth, it shaves a true square edge on boards and on the edges of a book.
name: plough

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter IX, p.127. Internet Archive.
